description: Commit and push the user's shared Claude config to the `~/.claude-config` sync repo, rebasing first so a push never buries work from another machine. Bootstraps the repo when it is missing. Never force-pushes, never rewrites pushed history, never creates a public remote, and touches nothing outside `~/.claude-config/`.
